cards.summary: Road or runway receding to a vanishing point at the top centre, but broken into many black wedge and block slabs of different sizes with white gaps between them, so it looks cracked, tiled or glitched. About 20 small enclosed white gaps. Reads as a paved path; the use is inferred.
avoid: the meaning is inferred from the shape: it can read as noise rather than a road
many small gaps collapse into black below about 300 px
cards.applies_to: shape layer / vector path: drawn with the Custom Shape tool as a Shape layer (Fill and Stroke stay editable, it scales without loss); Path mode gives an outline for clipping or vector masks, Pixels mode paints it into a pixel layer. It is not an effect and does nothing to photo content by itself.
cards.how_to_apply: By script (the route PGD used for the thumbnail): load <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Required/Legacy Shapes and More.csh as custom shapes, then Action Manager make on a contentLayer whose shape is a customShape descriptor with this name, this ID ('a59e0b68-f911-ca48-ae6d-df2b52714a41': the .csh file stores it as $a59e0b68-f911-ca48-ae6d-df2b52714a41, the PGD renderer passes it without the $) and Top/Left/Btom/Rght pixel bounds plus a solidColorLayer fill; the library must be loaded first. In the interface the Custom Shape tool (U, Shift+U cycles the shape tools) should list it in the shape picker (options bar) or Shapes panel under the group path 'Legacy Shapes and More/2019 Shapes/Roads and Streams' as stored in the .csh file; PGD did not drive the picker, so those clicks are inferred, not observed. Drag on the canvas (Shift keeps proportions) and set Fill / Stroke in the options bar.
cards.notes: PGD thumbnail: applied in Photoshop as a custom shape layer (by name and ID), filled near-black on white and fitted to the shape's own aspect ratio. Shapes are single-colour paths: white areas inside the black are holes (cut-outs) in the path, not white paint. Pixel check of the 320 px thumbnail: 20 fully enclosed white hole(s), so those are cut-outs in the path; any other white inside the outline is open to the page.

verified.note: Perspective road broken into black slabs and wedges (eight pieces) with about 20 noticeable enclosed white gaps.
